acceptance: A test drives the real order: the cycle finishes, then the no-work close-out runs, then the seal is checked, and the seal has RoutesMeasured true and the routed ids sorted.
A held_proposals.stage decision for an item the close-out routed scores Conflicts == 1 through DefaultScorer from that real seal.
A cycle whose close-out never ran keeps RoutesMeasured false and the stage not ready with conflicts_unmeasured.
A resume does not read routes from a handoff of an earlier attempt.
fix: Carry the routed ids into the seal at the point where they are known: either move the no-work routing inside the cycle before finish, or re-seal (SealInput.Routed plus RoutesMeasured true, sorted) from the cmd close-out after ApplyNoWork returns res.Routed. Set RoutesMeasured only from that real source, never from a file left by an earlier attempt.
routed_reason: lane triage (cycle 2642) dropped: stale: seal.go has no RoutesMeasured and no held_proposals.stage in Go source; PR 1690 premise not at HEAD
source: console build of #1690 r3 delta review, 2026-11-23
summary: The stage seal of a cycle is built in stageSession.finish inside RunCycle, but the cycle routed item ids are written by cycleoutcome.ApplyNoWork only after RunCycle returns (cmd_cycle.go:281). PR #1690 therefore makes the conflict class fail closed: Seal.RoutesMeasured is false and held_proposals.stage reads not ready (conflicts_unmeasured). This item wires the routes in the real order so the conflict class is measured.
title: The stage seal carries the cycle's routed items, so the held-proposal conflict class is measured and no longer fails closed
